description: Drishti pilot benchmark: 30 descriptions (8 in Kannada or romanised Kannada) over the 8 demo cameras. Each query lists EVERY person in the footage who fits it, as an anchor [camera, time s, centre x, centre y] (x, y as fractions of the frame), labelled by hand from per-person contact sheets. A search result counts as correct only if that person's tracked path passes within 1 s and 0.12 frame-widths of an anchor.
